wsjHeadlines.title: Stock Market Today: Nasdaq Slides 2.5% as Nvidia Drama Continues
wsjHeadlines.description: U.S. moves to crack down on overseas players accessing advanced AI chips remotely; bitcoin under pressure

wsjHeadlines.title: AI Stocks Resume Their Slide
wsjHeadlines.description: Plus, the Fed weighs AI jobs scenarios and Tyson improves its beef outlook

wsjHeadlines.title: Berkshire Boosts Stake in Lennar, Doubling Down on Its U.S. Housing Bet
wsjHeadlines.description: The conglomerate formerly run by Warren Buffett also trimmed stakes in Capital One and Nucor during the September quarter.

wsjHeadlines.title: Kalshi Buys Securities Firm to Expand Into Stock Trading
wsjHeadlines.description: The prediction-markets platform, still fighting legal battles with U.S. states over its yes-or-no contracts, wants to expand into other assets.

wsjHeadlines.title: When Nvidia Stumbled, Equal-Weight Funds Delivered
wsjHeadlines.description: Plus, tech stocks start the week under pressure.

wsjHeadlines.title: The Investors Set to Win Big in Anthropic’s IPO
wsjHeadlines.description: Venture-capital firms, top tech companies and sovereign-wealth funds are poised for windfalls.

wsjHeadlines.title: Big Tech Needs to Spread Its Bets on Data Centers
wsjHeadlines.description: Artificial-intelligence players that bet too much on a handful of mega projects look vulnerable after the midterm elections.

wsjHeadlines.title: Gucci Is Cutting Prices. Louis Vuitton Is Reluctant to Follow the Trend.
wsjHeadlines.description: With luxury demand weak, executives are debating one of the sector’s big taboos.

wsjHeadlines.title: CVS Breakup Won’t Satisfy Washington. It Could Still Work for Wall Street.
wsjHeadlines.description: Spinning off its drugstores won’t quiet CVS’s critics, but it could leave shareholders with a more valuable company.

wsjHeadlines.title: Nvidia Shareholders Won’t Miss Jensen Huang for Long
wsjHeadlines.description: Steadier hands could be better suited to enriching shareholders as the AI chip company enters a new phase.

wsjHeadlines.title: Nvidia’s Disappearing Singapore Sales Deepen Mystery Around Megaspeed
wsjHeadlines.description: Last year, just as scrutiny of Megaspeed was rising, Nvidia stopped reporting Singapore revenue.

wsjHeadlines.title: CoreWeave Finds a Workaround to Capital Constraints—for Now
wsjHeadlines.description: The company’s ambitious plans will still require cooperation from capital markets.

wsjHeadlines.title: Anthropic Chief Tells Jamie Dimon He Hopes IPO Will ‘Underpromise and Overdeliver’
wsjHeadlines.description: The artificial-intelligence giant, which is expected to begin trading Thursday, is targeting a valuation of roughly $1.33 trillion or more.

wsjHeadlines.title: AI Bots Are Using Credit Cards. Banks Are Racing to Keep Up.
wsjHeadlines.description: Stripe is positioning itself as a key cog for agentic commerce, while JPMorgan Chase is a skeptic.

wsjHeadlines.title: Metro Bank Hangs Up ‘For Sale’ Sign
wsjHeadlines.description: The lender said Thursday that it wasn’t in any active discussions and it hadn’t received an approach for a potential takeover.

wsjHeadlines.title: SEC Enforcement Penalties Fall to 18-Year Low
wsjHeadlines.description: The Wall Street regulator obtained about $1 billion last year, the lowest amount since the 2008 financial crisis.

wsjHeadlines.title: Wall Street Pay Set to Climb After Volatile Markets and IPOs Fuel Bank Profits
wsjHeadlines.description: Traders and investment bankers are set to see among the biggest bumps in bonuses.

wsjHeadlines.title: Crypto Stuck Near Multimonth Lows After Sluggish Weekend
wsjHeadlines.description: Crypto started the week on a downbeat note with both Bitcoin and Ethereum trading around key support levels as risk appetite remains constrained.

wsjHeadlines.title: Treasury Yields Slip to Start Busy Week
wsjHeadlines.description: Treasury yields started the week declining, as Fed Chairman Warsh refrained from giving hints about the path of interest rates.

wsjHeadlines.title: U.S. Stocks Fall as Nvidia Drama Continues
wsjHeadlines.description: U.S. stocks fell as the fallout from a spying scandal at Nvidia continued to unfold.

wsjHeadlines.title: Treasury Yields Fall, German Bunds’ Tick Higher
wsjHeadlines.description: U.S. Treasury yields declined, reversing some of the gains posted last week prompted by inflation data and hawkish Federal Reserve comments.

wsjHeadlines.title: Activist Calls on Landlord Invitation Homes to Sell Houses ‘One at a Time’
wsjHeadlines.description: Land & Buildings says the company should sell homes and buy back shares after a ban on large investors buying single-family homes threatens to limit its growth.

wsjHeadlines.title: U.S. Stocks Extend Slide on Nvidia, China Fears
wsjHeadlines.description: U.S. stocks fell sharply, with the S&P 500 suffering its third straight decline and its sharpest since Nvidia’s CEO resigned last week.

wsjHeadlines.title: Nvidia Earnings, Anthropic IPO Ahead in New Test for AI Economy
wsjHeadlines.description: Plus, where does Nvidia go from here?

wsjHeadlines.title: European Stock Indexes Mixed at Start of Crucial Week
wsjHeadlines.description: European stock indexes were mixed to kick off a crucial week for markets that features Nvidia earnings and Anthropic’s public listing.

wsjHeadlines.title: Asian Equities Drop as U.S. Chip Selloff Spills Over
wsjHeadlines.description: The U.S. chip selloff on Friday spread to Asia, with Taiwan’s Taiex leading regional markets lower as the island’s chip and hardware makers fell sharply.

wsjHeadlines.title: The End of the No-Brainer AI Trade
wsjHeadlines.description: A punishing bout of volatility, stretching from the Nasdaq’s Oct. 6 peak to Jensen Huang’s Nvidia exit, exposed the risks of groupthink on Wall Street

wsjHeadlines.title: Opinion | Can Nvidia Thrive Without Jensen Huang?
wsjHeadlines.description: The company’s prospects depends on whether its board is able to avoid a series of common pitfalls.

wsjHeadlines.title: Opinion | Rational Investing and Stock-Market Bubbles
wsjHeadlines.description: Readers debate investor behavior and how markets price risk.

wsjHeadlines.title: Opinion | What’s Really Behind Data Center Backlash
wsjHeadlines.description: Midterm results aren’t a rejection of the technology itself but of the way developers handle projects.

wsjHeadlines.title: Opinion | Congressional Insider Trading Isn’t as Common as You Think
wsjHeadlines.description: As with Mr. Pelosi’s Alphabet options, many insider-trading claims fall apart under scrutiny.

wsjHeadlines.title: Opinion | ‘Peer-to-Peer’ Wagering Isn’t Gambling? Don’t Bet on It
wsjHeadlines.description: Kalshi says it is different from a sportsbook. Utah says Kalshi’s own trading arm acts like the house.

wsjHeadlines.title: Opinion | Building Wealth Requires More Than Charity
wsjHeadlines.description: Handouts can’t scale to a whole nation. A market-based path to ownership can.

wsjHeadlines.title: U.S. Natural Gas Futures Settle Lower
wsjHeadlines.description: U.S. natural gas futures added to Friday’s losses as production picked up and near-term weather turned warmer.

wsjHeadlines.title: Oil Futures Retreat on Expected Global Surplus
wsjHeadlines.description: Oil prices extended losses as analysts and experts say the global market faces a growing surplus next year, despite persistent risks in the Middle East.

wsjHeadlines.title: Oil Prices Retreat as Market Digests Global Surplus Expectations
wsjHeadlines.description: Oil prices fell as traders weighed expectations of a global supply surplus against renewed threats to Middle Eastern oil shipments.

wsjHeadlines.title: Gold Futures Settle at New 52-Week Low
wsjHeadlines.description: Gold futures settled at their lowest level in more than a year as the U.S. dollar extended gains.

wsjHeadlines.title: The Next Wave of Food Inflation Is Coming
wsjHeadlines.description: Grocery prices could increase again as surging energy costs and supply-chain delays are lifting costs for producers.

wsjHeadlines.title: Yen Could Strengthen Versus Dollar by Year-End
wsjHeadlines.description: The Japanese yen was little changed against the dollar, but could appreciate towards year-end, supported by improving economic conditions in Japan, fund inflows and the Bank of Japan raising interest rates, Bank of America forex strategists said.

wsjHeadlines.title: Asian Currencies Consolidate, But May Be Weighed by Risk-Off Sentiment
wsjHeadlines.description: Asian currencies consolidated against the dollar, but may be weighed by risk-off sentiment.
